purpose: You Were Made for a Mission

group.title: Made for a Mission
group.point: I was made for a mission.
group.question: What fears have kept me from fulfilling the mission God made me to accomplish? What keeps me from telling others the Good News?

group.title: Sharing Your Life Message
group.point: God wants to say something to the world through me.
group.question: As I reflect on my personal story, who does God want me to share it with?

group.title: Becoming a World-Class Christian
group.point: The Great Commission is my commission.
group.question: What steps can I take to prepare to go on a short-term missions experience in the next year?

group.title: Balancing Your Life
group.question: Which of the four activities will I begin in order to stay on track and balance God’s five purposes for my life?

group.title: Living with Purpose
group.point: Living with purpose is the only way to really live.
group.question: When will I take the time to write down my answers to life’s five great questions? When will I put my purpose on paper?

group.title: The Envy Trap
group.point: I cannot fulfill God’s purpose for me if I am envying others.
group.question: In what areas of my life do I most often compare myself with and envy others?

group.title: The People-Pleaser Trap
group.point: Happiness is my choice. I don’t need anyone’s approval to be happy.
group.question: Whose opinion matters most to me? Whose approval am I living for?
